subject: radiology
title: Barium Swallow, Meal, Follow Through and Enema Signs

steps.title: Barium swallow maps the oesophagus
steps.tx: **Barium swallow** coats the oesophagus with barium while fluoroscopy watches swallowing in real time, catching strictures, rings, diverticula and motility failure in one study. The pictured examination shows achalasia, where the lower oesophagus tapers smoothly to a beak while the body above dilates and holds food residue. A malignant stricture instead shoulders abruptly with irregular mucosa, and that shoulder separates cancer from benign narrowing.

A malignant stricture shoulders abruptly instead, separating cancer from benign narrowing.

steps.title: Bird beak versus rat tail
steps.tx: **Bird beak sign** is the smooth tapered narrowing of achalasia at the gastro oesophageal junction, with a dilated barium filled oesophagus above it. Rat tail appearance describes the long irregular tapered stricture of oesophageal carcinoma eating through the wall. Both narrow the same junction, but the beak keeps a smooth mucosal line and a dilated proximal tube, while the rat tail destroys mucosa and fixes the segment.

Rat tail describes the long irregular stricture of carcinoma eating through the wall. The beak keeps a smooth mucosal line, while the rat tail destroys mucosa and fixes the segment.

steps.title: Barium meal reads stomach and duodenum
steps.tx: **Barium meal** follows swallowed barium through stomach and duodenal cap to find ulcers, tumours and outlet obstruction. A benign gastric ulcer projects beyond the expected stomach contour as a niche on the lesser curve, while a malignant ulcer sits inside the contour within a mass. Duodenal ulcer craters fill in the cap and deform it into a clover leaf after repeated scarring episodes.

steps.title: Follow through and the string sign
steps.tx: **Barium follow through** tracks a meal through jejunum and ileum over hours, photographing the terminal ileum where Crohn disease declares itself. The string sign of Kantor is a thread thin barium stream through a long inflamed, spastic and later fibrotic terminal ileal segment. Skip lesions, cobblestoning from longitudinal ulcers and separation of loops by thickened walls complete the Crohn pattern that colonoscopy then biopsies.

The string sign of Kantor is a thread thin stream through a long inflamed terminal ileal segment. Skip lesions and cobblestoning complete the pattern that colonoscopy then biopsies.

steps.title: Barium enema and apple core
steps.tx: **Barium enema** fills the colon from below, and its cancer signature is the apple core lesion: a short circumferential narrowing with shouldered ends and destroyed mucosa, pictured here in carcinoma of the colon. Benign strictures taper longer and smoother with intact mucosa. Double contrast technique coats the wall with thin barium and distends with air, exposing polyps as filling defects that single contrast studies bury in the pool.

Benign strictures taper longer and smoother. Double contrast coats the wall thinly and distends with air, exposing polyps as filling defects.

steps.title: Lead pipe colon and thumbprinting
steps.tx: **Lead pipe colon** is the featureless, shortened, rigid colon of chronic ulcerative colitis after years of inflammation burn out the haustral folds. Thumbprinting instead marks acute submucosal oedema and haemorrhage swelling the folds into thumb shaped indentations, seen in ischaemic colitis and acute severe colitis. One sign is chronic burnout over years, the other is an acute swollen wall over days, and examiners swap them deliberately.
steps.say: Lead pipe colon is the featureless shortened colon of chronic ulcerative colitis after years of inflammation burn out the haustra. Thumbprinting marks acute submucosal oedema swelling folds into thumb shaped indentations in ischaemic or severe colitis. One is chronic burnout over years, the other an acute swollen wall over days.

steps.title: When barium is forbidden
steps.tx: **Suspected perforation** forbids barium because leaked barium sulphate in peritoneum or mediastinum provokes severe chemical inflammation and granulomas that complicate surgery. Water soluble Gastrografin goes first and surgery follows a positive leak without waiting for barium detail. After a negative Gastrografin study with continuing suspicion, thin barium may follow because its coating finds small leaks the water soluble agent washed past.

steps.title: Filling defect versus coating defect
steps.tx: **Filling defect** means something occupies space where barium should be: polyp, tumour, bezoar or an extrinsic impression pushing the wall inward. Extrinsic compression keeps mucosa smooth and shifts with the compressing organ, while a polyp rises from the wall itself and traps a barium fleck on its surface. Reporting the defect size, stalk and mucosal state decides whether colonoscopy, CT or simple follow up comes next.
